scenario.description: A Product Operations Lead must finalize the retirement plan for a legacy public API, including the retirement date, compatibility period, and customer migration support, after the routine release-readiness review.

shared_context.S1: The public v1 reporting API is currently targeted for retirement on September 30.
shared_context.S2: Riley makes the final call on the retirement plan and records the commitments for the release program.
shared_context.S3: The replacement v2 reporting API is available and has passed the documented compatibility tests.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal release-readiness process, Riley reviews the plan with API platform and customer success before it is finalized.

PF1.text: Owen confirmed with the account team this morning that the Northstar contract requires 60 days of notice before the v1 reporting API is retired and guarantees access through November 14. To honor the guarantee, the retirement should take effect on November 15, the day after guaranteed access ends; he found the clause while preparing a renewal brief and has not yet added it to the release record.

PF2.text: Mina confirmed while reviewing mobile telemetry today that the current mobile SDK still calls v1 for 38% of reporting requests, and SDK 6.4 will not reach the required adoption level until November 10; v1 must therefore remain dual-served through November 14, with a migration clinic needed for affected application teams, but she has not filed the platform note yet.

acceptance_conditions: The retirement date must be November 14 or November 15, while honoring guaranteed access through November 14.
The plan must require customer notice.
The v1 API must remain dual-served through November 14.
A migration clinic for affected application teams must be committed.
The contract notice constraint must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c.get('type') == 'customer_notice' and 'Northstar' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c.get('type') == 'migration_clinic' and ('application teams' in c.get('detail', '') or 'application_teams' in c.get('target', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The contract changes the retirement plan from September 30 to November 14 or November 15, turns customer notice from optional to required, and requires a Northstar-specific notice commitment.
The mobile SDK adoption numbers change compatibility from immediate v1 retirement to dual-serving through November 14 and add a migration clinic commitment for affected application teams.
